where: Section 2 (last paragraph) and the figure caption
problem: It says 'AR and VR are two ends of one line' and captions AR and VR as 'the two ends'. This contradicts the same section, which correctly puts the real environment at the left end and the virtual environment at the right end. AR sits near the real end; it is not an end of the line. A student could reproduce this wrong statement in an exam.
fix: Write: 'Notice that AR and VR sit on one line, not on two unrelated lines. The ends of the line are the real environment (left) and the virtual environment (right); AR sits near the real end and VR at the virtual end.' In the caption: 'AR and VR are picked out as the two points exams ask you to separate.'

problem: 'Lays virtual content over a live view of the real world' reads as if a camera view is always required. In optical see-through AR the user looks straight through the glass and there is no camera image on a screen.
fix: Write: 'AR lays virtual content over the user's view of the real world. The view may come through a camera (video see-through) or through a see-through glass display (optical see-through).'
